title: Ordinary scalar tensor coordinates and total pullback naturality
statement: Let f:Z→T, a:A→B, F the exact ordinary A-module complex pullback, C=r(B)[0], and k:F(C)≅C_Z the fixed coefficient complex identification. Put TT(P,Q)=Tot(P tensor Q), TZ for the corresponding tensor on Z, and j_P=totalPullback(P,C)^{-1} followed by TZ(1,k). For every complex map q:Q→C, F(TT(1,q)) ≫ j_P = totalPullback(P,Q)^{-1} ≫ TZ(1,Fq ≫ k). No K-flatness, flatness of B or boundedness is assumed. This node also defines κ_a(P) by the restricted derived scalar counit and exact restriction localization factor, and the one-sided scalar coordinates e_a(QP)^{-1} κ_a(P) Q(ordinaryComplexIso.hom), all by explicit composites.

proof.text: Take the natural isomorphism of total complexes supplied by the tensor descent data. Its naturality at (1,q) gives compatibility with the inverse total pullback comparison. Postcompose with TZ(1,k), use functoriality and identity preservation of the uncurried total bifunctor, and obtain the formula with Fq followed by k. The single-complex coefficient map is the specified unit-normalized one. All four auxiliary maps in this module are defined by the displayed actual composites.

theorem tensorScalarOrdinaryPullback_naturality
    {Z T : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ T)
    {A B : Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1}} (a : A ⟶ B)
    (P Q : CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules T A) ℤ)
    (q : Q ⟶ coefficientComplex a) :
    let F := (proEtaleRingModulePullback f A (inverseRing f A)
      (Iso.refl _)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let TT := Functor.uncurry.obj ((proEtaleOrdinaryTensor T A).map₂HomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ) (.up ℤ) (.up ℤ))
    let TZ := Functor.uncurry.obj ((proEtaleOrdinaryTensor Z (inverseRing f A)
      ).map₂HomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) (.up ℤ) (.up ℤ))
    F.map (TT.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 P) q)) ≫ tensorScalarOrdinaryPullback f a P =
      (proEtaleTensorPullbackTotalIso f A (inverseRing f A) (Iso.refl _) P Q).inv ≫
        TZ.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 (F.obj P))
          (F.map q ≫ (tensorCoefficientComplexPullback f a).hom))
